patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LiveChat and Tidio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

LiveChat and Tidio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose LiveChat only if your buying job matches “Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per ” rather than Tidio's shape. Choose Tidio only if your buying job matches “Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $” rather than LiveChat's shape. Workflow advantage: LiveChat leans shared coverage; Tidio leans ai-customer-service. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LiveChat and Tidio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: LiveChat is Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per person/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Tidio is Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $49.17. Primary live-chat; CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: LiveChat (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Tidio (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: LiveChat-leaning — vs Tidio-leaning ai-customer-service.
- Researched limits: LiveChat — ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; Tidio — Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers.

Limitations — LiveChat: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; No free plan — trial-only entry; Tidio: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers; Not a full helpdesk/ITSM — thin ticketing vs Freshdesk.

Poor-fit cases: LiveChat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases · Tidio is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers · Avoid LiveChat if you actually need Tidio's motion (Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Gro)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
